description_en: Creates an asynchronous export task to export the WUYING server list, user usage report, cloud browser bookmarks, or URL whitelist
description_zh: 创建异步导出任务，导出无影主机列表、用户使用情况报告、云浏览器书签或 URL 白名单
name: CreateExportTask

parameters.help_en:
The type of the export task. This parameter is required and case-sensitive. Valid values:
WUYING_SERVER_LIST: WUYING server list.
USER_USAGE_REPORT: User usage report.
BROWSER_BOOKMARK_LIST: Cloud browser bookmark list.
BROWSER_RESTRICTED_URL_LIST: Cloud browser URL whitelist.

Different task types use different QueryParamJson query conditions. Only WUYING_SERVER_LIST supports selecting export columns by using ExportFields
parameters.help_zh:
导出任务类型，调用时必填，取值区分大小写：
WUYING_SERVER_LIST：无影主机列表。
USER_USAGE_REPORT：用户使用情况报告。
BROWSER_BOOKMARK_LIST：云浏览器书签列表。
BROWSER_RESTRICTED_URL_LIST：云浏览器 URL 白名单。

不同类型使用不同的 QueryParamJson 查询条件；仅 WUYING_SERVER_LIST 支持通过 ExportFields 选择导出列
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The JSON string serialized from the query condition object. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. Field names must use the following lower camel case format.

WUYING_SERVER_LIST: If no filter condition is specified, pass the JSON string corresponding to {}. Only wuyingServerIdList, wuyingServerNameOrId, status, bizRegionId, zoneId, officeSiteId, serverInstanceType, imageId, chargeType, virtualNodePoolId, addVirtualNodePoolStatusList, users, networkInterfaceIp, createTimeStart, createTimeEnd, expiredTimeStart, and expiredTimeEnd are supported. The semantics of each field are the same as those in ListWuyingServer. Pagination or other unlisted fields cannot be passed. The values of wuyingServerIdList, addVirtualNodePoolStatusList, and users must be serialized into JSON array strings before the outer query object is serialized.
BROWSER_BOOKMARK_LIST and BROWSER_RESTRICTED_URL_LIST: The object must and can only contain browserInstanceGroupId, and the value must be a non-empty cloud browser delivery group ID string. It cannot contain Keyword, pagination, or other fields.
USER_USAGE_REPORT: Use productType, startDate, and endDate to specify the product type and query time range. You can use appInstanceGroupId, bizRegionId, userId, and connectionStatus for filtering. startDate and endDate must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. Query parameters are parsed and verified during the asynchronous execution phase. A successful creation does not mean that all these query conditions have passed verification
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件对象序列化后的 JSON 字符串，调用时必填，不能传空字符串。字段名使用下列小驼峰形式。

WUYING_SERVER_LIST：无筛选条件时传入 {} 对应的 JSON 字符串。仅支持 wuyingServerIdList、wuyingServerNameOrId、status、bizRegionId、zoneId、officeSiteId、serverInstanceType、imageId、chargeType、virtualNodePoolId、addVirtualNodePoolStatusList、users、networkInterfaceIp、createTimeStart、createTimeEnd、expiredTimeStart、expiredTimeEnd。各字段语义沿用 ListWuyingServer；不能传入分页或其他未列出的字段。wuyingServerIdList、addVirtualNodePoolStatusList 和 users 的值需先序列化为 JSON 数组字符串，再序列化外层查询对象。
BROWSER_BOOKMARK_LIST、BROWSER_RESTRICTED_URL_LIST：对象必须且只能包含 browserInstanceGroupId，值为非空的云浏览器交付组 ID 字符串；不能包含 Keyword、分页或其他字段。
USER_USAGE_REPORT：使用 productType、startDate、endDate 指定产品类型和查询时间范围；可用 appInstanceGroupId、bizRegionId、userId、connectionStatus 筛选。startDate 和 endDate 使用 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 格式。查询参数在异步执行阶段解析和校验，创建成功不代表这些查询条件已全部通过校验
parameters.name: query_param_json

parameters.help_en:
The list of field codes for export columns. This parameter is optional and applies only to WUYING_SERVER_LIST. Do not pass this parameter for other task types. You can pass up to 100 elements. The codes are case-sensitive. Leading and trailing spaces in fields are removed, and blank elements are ignored. Duplicate codes are retained in the order of their first appearance. WuyingServerId is always the first column, and the remaining columns are exported in the order specified in the request. If this parameter is not passed, only WuyingServerId is exported.

Supported codes: WuyingServerId, WuyingServerName, Status, BizRegionId, ZoneId, OfficeSiteId, ServerInstanceType, ServerInstanceTypeId, Cpu, Memory, Image, OsType, ImageId, SystemDisk, DataDisks, NetworkInterfaceIp, PrivateIpSets, SecurityGroupIds, Bandwidth, ChargeType, SubPayType, VirtualNodePool, CreateTime, ExpiredTime, and VirtualKubeletInfo.

In the original RPC request, pass the parameters sequentially as ExportFields.1, ExportFields.2, and so on. For example, ExportFields.1=WuyingServerId and ExportFields.2=Status
parameters.help_zh:
导出列的字段编码列表，可选，仅适用于 WUYING_SERVER_LIST，其他任务类型不传。最多传入 100 个元素，编码区分大小写；字段首尾空白会被移除，空白元素忽略，重复编码按首次出现顺序保留。WuyingServerId 始终为首列，其余列按请求顺序导出；不传时仅导出 WuyingServerId。

支持的编码为：WuyingServerId、WuyingServerName、Status、BizRegionId、ZoneId、OfficeSiteId、ServerInstanceType、ServerInstanceTypeId、Cpu、Memory、Image、OsType、ImageId、SystemDisk、DataDisks、NetworkInterfaceIp、PrivateIpSets、SecurityGroupIds、Bandwidth、ChargeType、SubPayType、VirtualNodePool、CreateTime、ExpiredTime、VirtualKubeletInfo。

原始 RPC 请求使用 ExportFields.1、ExportFields.2 依次传入，例如 ExportFields.1=WuyingServerId、ExportFields.2=Status
parameters.name: export_fields

schema.description_en: The response for creating an export task, which includes the request ID and the newly created task information
schema.description_zh: 创建导出任务的响应，包含请求 ID 和新建任务信息

ExportTaskModel.description_en: The information about the newly created export task. When the task is created, Status is INIT, Progress is 0, and the download URL and error message are empty
ExportTaskModel.description_zh: 新建的导出任务信息。创建成功时 Status 为 INIT、Progress 为 0，下载地址和错误信息为空

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format, accurate to seconds. The returned string does not include the time zone offset
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，精确到秒，返回字符串不包含时区偏移

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the exported file. When the task is created by calling this operation, the file is not generated and this field is empty. The null in the example represents a JSON null value, not the string "null". You can subsequently call DescribeExportTasks to query the latest download URL of the completed task and use it within the validity period
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 导出文件下载地址。本接口创建任务时文件尚未生成，该字段为空值；示例中的 null 表示 JSON 空值，不是字符串 "null"。后续通过 DescribeExportTasks 查询已完成任务的最新下载地址，并在有效期内使用

ErrorMsg.description_en: The error message when the task execution fails. When the task is created by calling this operation, this field is empty. The null in the example represents a JSON null value, not the string "null". When you query the task status and it is FAILED, you can use this field to identify the cause of the failure
ErrorMsg.description_zh: 任务执行失败时的错误信息。本接口创建成功时该字段为空值；示例中的 null 表示 JSON 空值，不是字符串 "null"。后续查询任务状态为 FAILED 时，可通过该字段了解失败原因

Progress.description_en: The progress of the export task. The value is a percentage ranging from 0 to 100. When the task is created by calling this operation, 0 is returned. The value is updated based on the execution phase and reaches 100 when the task is completed
Progress.description_zh: 导出任务进度，单位为百分比，范围为 0～100。本接口创建成功时返回 0，后续按执行阶段更新，任务完成时为 100

Status.description_en: The status of the task. When the task is created by calling this operation, INIT (initialized and waiting for execution) is returned. You can subsequently call DescribeExportTasks to query RUNNING (executing), FINISHED (completed), or FAILED (failed). Do not treat INIT as export completion
Status.description_zh: 任务状态。本接口创建成功时返回 INIT（初始化、等待执行）。后续通过 DescribeExportTasks 查询 RUNNING（执行中）、FINISHED（已完成）或 FAILED（失败）；不要将 INIT 视为导出完成

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the newly created export task. The value is a 32-character UUID string without hyphens. You can use this value as the TaskId parameter to query the task in DescribeExportTasks
TaskId.description_zh: 新建导出任务的 ID，为不含短横线的 32 位 UUID 字符串。可作为 DescribeExportTasks 的 TaskId 参数查询该任务

TaskType.description_en: The type of the export task. The value is the same as the TaskType in the request. For the meaning of each type, see the TaskType request parameter
TaskType.description_zh: 导出任务类型，与本次请求的 TaskType 一致；各类型含义见请求参数 TaskType

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate call records and troubleshoot issues. The example value is partially desensitized
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于定位调用记录和排查问题。示例为部分脱敏值
